# 0.1.8 — First-time setup templates, platform TOML, and GitHub docs paths

16 September 2026. Patch on the public **0.1.7** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.1.8
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Added

- VS Code snippets use `tide-threat` / `tide-objective` / `tide-rule` / `tide-<platform>` prefixes, `scope: yaml`, descriptions, and tabstops ([#194](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/194)).
- `opentide setup vscode --mcp` writes `.vscode/mcp.json`. Parent `--vscode-setup` does not imply MCP ([#193](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/193)).

## Fixed

- Missing `objects/*` folders log at debug, not error ([#212](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/212)).
- Optional `#key:` template subtrees comment nested children so YAML does not attach them to the previous mapping ([#209](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/209)).
- Generated templates never emit YAML `null`; typed placeholders are restored ([#210](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/210)).
- `opentide setup repo --platform` writes enabled platform TOML so generate emits configuration stubs ([#211](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/211)).
- Objective docs render `priority` as the author string, not a `criticality::1.0` token ([#204](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/204)).
- GitHub/generic docs use lowercase `docs/{rules,objectives,threats}/<slug>.md`; UUID permalinks stay GitLab-only ([#203](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/203)).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide setup --yes --name "Tutorial Detections" --org "Example Corp" --platform sentinel --path /tmp/tutorial-detections
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections generate
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections validate --strict
```

Expect `0.1.8`. The scaffold must contain `.opentide/configurations/platforms/sentinel.toml` with `enabled = true`, and `.opentide/templates/rule.1.0.template.yaml` must contain `#sentinel:` and no YAML `null`.
